claim_scope: Best among named executable comparators on specified endpoints and versioned data only

splits.unit: patient, grouping every record/page/view derived from that patient
splits.generator_device_layout_holdout: additional axes, not substitutes for patient independence
splits.public_data_overlap: record per method, checkpoint and source ID before interpreting rankings

datasets.ahus_printed_segment: first 5 s of 10 s archived waveform, 2 Cabrera pages, 50 mm/s, 10 mm/mV
datasets.role: public reproduction, capture and waveform benchmark
datasets.overlap_note: Ahus used by original npj validation, public cohort is not a blind test against those weights
datasets.materialization: manifest first, granular listing, subset before full download

datasets.annotation: two annotators with adjudication, uncertainty and landmarks held out from fitting
datasets.sample_size: final power and group count determined from separate pilot before final evaluation

baseline_registry.execution: cached old replay only this investigation
weights lock and fresh run pending
checkpoint availability and fresh run pending
weights lock and fresh run pending
public checkpoint in tree, not downloaded or executed
public checkpoints announced, not downloaded or executed
announced external weights not downloaded or executed
proprietary executable and weights unavailable here, not ranked as failure

tracks.outputs: physical coordinates with declared eligible domain
tracks.original_fallback: may retain separately scored partial coordinates

tracks.outputs: rectified image with physical density/aspect and frame retention
tracks.original_fallback: content-preserving abstention, not successful global rectification

tracks.provided_equally: paper units, speed, gain and reference metadata
image only, with explicit permitted metadata

tracks.rule: freeze signal extractor, layout and printed windows across rectifiers
native rectification and extraction, separately labeled

geometry.domain: predefined visible paper independent of predictions, including headers and missing-grid areas
geometry.exclude: truly occluded material and photographic background from physical chart scoring
geometry.G: fraction of fixed queries returned finite with physical error <= threshold
geometry.W: fraction of fixed queries returned finite with physical error > threshold
geometry.aggregation: patient mean across predefined views and queries, balanced source/backend diagnostics
geometry.evaluation_alignment: no fitted scale, shear, affine, polarity or nonuniform time rescaling
geometry.gauge_track: discrete axis/sign/origin only if preregistered, separate strict orientation endpoint
geometry.real_landmarks: sparse independent physical landmarks do not constitute dense gold after interpolation

baseline_fairness: common frozen posthoc quality gate when native uncertainty unavailable
selection.crc_limit: standard monotone expected-loss CRC does not automatically bound R or arbitrary distribution shift
selection.current_calibration: 6-patient cohorts cannot support a nontrivial 1% CRC promise

signal.lead_and_window_conventions: Cabrera/-aVR and sequential windows explicitly resolved
signal.scorer_shift_note: official 2024 allows up to 0.5 s and 1 mV shifts, reported separately

statistics.primary: paired patient-cluster differences, stratified by source
statistics.uncertainty: patient-cluster bootstrap or appropriate bounded-loss inference, preserve correlated views
statistics.multiplicity: preregistered family-wise control such as Holm or simultaneous intervals

proposed_engineering_gates.delta_G: adjusted 95% lower bound >0 against each named comparator, +3 percentage points practical point-estimate aim
proposed_engineering_gates.delta_W: 95% upper bound <= +0.2 percentage points versus strongest baseline selected on validation
proposed_engineering_gates.R_status: proposal to validate and freeze, not a certified risk bound
proposed_engineering_gates.coverage: no victory from near-zero returned coverage, compare at same coverage/risk operating points
proposed_engineering_gates.content: exact original archived on all inputs, zero analytical mask deletion, proposed 99.9% annotated-landmark retention
proposed_engineering_gates.waveform: improve common-extractor fidelity without predefined meaningful timing/amplitude degradation
proposed_engineering_gates.performance: publish quality/latency/memory Pareto table at matched resolution/output density and common hardware

latency.GPU: synchronize measurements, no CPU timing advertised as GPU timing

failure_policy.unavailable_methods: not executed, never converted into failed inference

publication: scripts, manifests, source IDs and aggregate/per-case metrics, no third-party full texts or datasets included here
